scores.notes: Watson, the bowler-hatted man carrying the bag, has the same dark moustache, fair skin, compact face and middle-aged appearance on both sides.
The seated passenger at left and the man being drawn inside at right share a neatly trimmed brown moustache, prominent nose, fair complexion and similar middle-aged face.
The seated Holmes and the man holding the match share dark curly hair, a long angular clean-shaven face, pale skin and a lean build.

Watson behind the table and the seated bowler-hatted passenger both have a short brown moustache, fair skin, a firm square jaw and similar middle-aged features; the hat hides much of his hair on the right.

The left shows the house facade and rose garden, but at right only smoke above a distant tree clump marks the fire. The house and its grounds are hidden there, preventing an architectural or layout comparison.

The burning house at left is under a dark night sky with a glowing hand lantern, while the station view at right has a bright daytime sky and sunlit fields; neither description requests that time change.
Watson seated in the train has a distinct dark moustache, whereas the bowler-hatted bag carrier beside Holmes on the pavement is clean-shaven.
Holmes has the same tousled dark curls, long sharp clean-shaven face and slender build in the train and on the pavement.
The bag-carrying Watson in the doorway is a young-looking clean-shaven man with a narrow face; the seated passenger on the right has a dark moustache and a broader, older-looking face.

The station and distant fire at left are shown in daylight under pale clouds; the house at right is shown under a deep blue night sky with lantern-lit figures. The descriptions do not call for a day-to-night change.
Watson on the bed has a brown moustache and lined middle-aged face, while the doorway bag carrier is clean-shaven and visibly younger with a narrower face.
Holmes holding Watson's arm and Holmes seated alone both have dark wavy curls, a pale angular clean-shaven face, prominent nose and slim build.
Watson leaning over the table and Watson on the bed share side-parted brown hair, a small brown moustache, fair skin and the same lined, broad middle-aged face.
Holmes holding the match and Holmes by the doorway both show short dark curls, high cheekbones, a long nose and a pale clean-shaven angular face.
The hat examiner and the seated Holmes have matching dark wavy hair, long narrow clean-shaven faces, sharp cheekbones and slender frames.
Holmes in the armchair and the man taking Watson's arm share dark curls, a long angular clean-shaven face, fair skin and the same lean build.
The right shows a white house, windows and rose bushes in detail; the left shows only a distant smoke plume behind trees, with no discernible house facade or garden layout to match.
The seated Holmes has full dark curls and a younger narrow face; the pavement Holmes has short slicked-back receding hair and a more lined, older angular face.
The doorway Watson is a youthful narrow-faced clean-shaven man; the pavement bag carrier has a distinctly broader square face, heavier brow and older lined appearance.
Holmes in the train and examining the hat has matching dark curls, pale skin, a long straight nose, angular jaw and clean-shaven face.
Holmes on the pavement and in the armchair has the same dark curly hair, pronounced cheekbones, long clean-shaven face and thin build.
The bowler-hatted Watson on the pavement has a bare upper lip, whereas Watson seated on the bed has a clearly drawn brown moustache.
The street Holmes and the match-holder share dark tousled curls, a pale elongated clean-shaven face and a lean frame; the brighter face at right is illuminated by the match.
Watson on the pavement is clean-shaven, while the man leaning over the table has a prominent brown moustache and swept side-parted brown hair.
Holmes examining the hat has thick loose curls and a youthful angular face; Holmes on the pavement has a receding slicked-back hairline and a visibly older, more lined face.

The left shows a compact three-window-wide house with a broad porch in daylight; the right shows a much wider many-windowed mansion with roof dormers at night. Both architecture and unrequested time of day conflict.

Both vault views have low brick arches on thick piers, large irregular stone floor slabs and wooden crates lining the passages. The warmer right-hand illumination is compatible with its open lantern versus the dim left-hand lantern.
Watson leaning on the table and the bowler-hatted man on the street have matching brown moustaches, fair skin, compact middle-aged faces and similar builds.
Holmes at the table and beside the doorway has matching dark curly hair, a long pointed nose, hollow cheeks and a pale clean-shaven face.
The match-holder and hat examiner share the same dark curls, long angular clean-shaven face and lean build, despite the different lighting and head angles.
Holmes on the bed and throwing the papers has the same full dark curls, narrow pale face, prominent cheekbones and long slim frame.

The left has a dark blue night sky and lantern-lit approach, whereas the close garden view at right has pale daylight across the facade and grounds. Neither description asks for this time-of-day change.

Both views show a low brick-vaulted cellar, broad cracked stone flags and stacked wooden bullion crates. The right-hand darkness is compatible with the described shuttered lantern and does not obscure the matching construction.
